title: Voting: host and containers
description: The questions the application's own metrics cannot answer: is the disk filling, is a container being killed, is the host out of memory. All series come from node-exporter and cadvisor.

panels.title: Host CPU (non-idle)
panels.description: CPU actually in use, derived from the idle counter rather than from a ready-made percentage so the units are unambiguous.

panels.title: Host memory available
panels.description: MemAvailable rather than MemFree: the kernel's own estimate of what a new workload could get, which counts reclaimable cache. MemFree reads alarmingly low on a healthy host that is caching disk, and an alert built on it would be ignored within a week.

panels.title: Filesystem space available
panels.description: tmpfs and overlay are filtered out because neither is the disk that fills up for real reasons; including them adds lines that never move and hides the one that does. This is the series the predicted-full alert is built on.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: How many times each container's start time changed in the last hour. A restart is the shape an out-of-memory kill takes, and it is otherwise invisible: the container comes back, every gauge resets, and nothing looks wrong unless you were watching at that second.

panels.title: Container memory usage
panels.description: Working set per container, against the limits set in the compose file. This is what explains a restart that panel 4 only reports.
